"""Isolated map lifecycle and paired polling check on real Edge and the full robot."""
import atexit, json, os, platform, secrets, tempfile, threading, time, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
import cv2
import numpy as np
from qdrant_edge import Point, UpdateOperation
from robot import main
from robot.config import SHARED
from robot.settings import Settings
from robot.things import DIM
started=time.time()
result={'run':'memory-map','machine':platform.node(),'release':os.environ['ROBOT_RELEASE'],
        'input':'oracle text, repeated development clock image, isolated synthetic storage',
        'tegrastats':os.environ['ROBOT_TEGRASTATS'],'checks':{},'snapshots':[],'blocks':[],'complete':False}
path=SHARED/'results'/f'{time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")}-memory-map-{int(started)}.json'
def save():
    path.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
atexit.register(save)
os.environ['ROBOT_VIEW_TOKEN']=secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
def vm():
    data=dict(line.split()[:2] for line in Path('/proc/vmstat').read_text().splitlines())
    return {k:int(data[k]) for k in ['pswpin','pswpout']}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=SHARED) as temp:
    root=Path(temp); main.settings=Settings(root/'settings.json')
    frame=cv2.imread('eval/dev/images/m2-clock.jpg');assert frame is not None
    camera=SimpleNamespace(latest=lambda:(frame,time.time()))
    robot=main.Robot(camera,root/'audio',memory=root/'memory',wake_word=False)
    try:
        def ask(text):
            robot.ask(text);turn=robot.next_turn(timeout=100);assert turn.answer
            return turn
        url=f'http://127.0.0.1:{robot.video.port}';token=os.environ['ROBOT_VIEW_TOKEN']
        def get(path):
            before=time.perf_counter()
            with urllib.request.urlopen(url+path+'?token='+token,timeout=10) as response:raw=response.read()
            return json.loads(raw),1000*(time.perf_counter()-before),len(raw)
        time.sleep(2)
        taught=ask('Track this as my clock');assert taught.named,taught.answer
        taught_snapshot,_,_=get('/memory_map')
        assert not taught_snapshot['recall']['ids'],'Teaching must not claim recall'
        recalled=ask('Where is my clock?')
        initial,_,_=get('/memory_map')
        assert initial['recall']['ids'] and f'things:{taught.named}' in initial['recall']['ids']
        result['checks']['real_recall_ids']=True
        result['checks']['no_teaching_recall']=True
        def seed(f,c):
            # Real points, isolated fixture payloads, no new model or storage format.
            owner=robot.things.new_visitor();vectors=np.eye(DIM,dtype=np.float32)[:1]
            for i in range(200):robot.things.name(owner,f'fixture {i}',['camera'],vectors,[frame])
            clock=time.time();points=[]
            for i in range(5000):
                pid=robot.memory._id()
                payload=({'said':f'Fixture statement {i}','ts':clock-i/10} if i%3==0 else
                         {'label':'clock','first_seen':clock-i/10,'last_seen':clock-i/10,'named':taught.named})
                points.append(Point(pid,{},payload))
            robot.memory.shard.update(UpdateOperation.upsert_points(points));robot.memory.shard.flush()
            return len(points)
        result['seeded_seen']=robot.recognition.call(seed,mutate=True)
        old_ids=set(initial['recall']['ids']);dense,_,_=get('/memory_map')
        assert old_ids<=set(dense['recall']['ids'])
        assert old_ids<=set(p['id'] for p in dense['nodes'])
        assert len(dense['nodes'])<=288 and dense['total']>=5201
        result['checks']['bounded_old_recall']=True
        result['sample']={'total':dense['total'],'shown':len(dense['nodes'])}
        # Snapshot read time and total owner wait are separate measurements.
        raw_reads=[];original=robot.memory.map_points
        def measured(ids):
            tick=time.perf_counter();value=original(ids);raw_reads.append(1000*(time.perf_counter()-tick));return value
        robot.memory.map_points=measured
        enabled=threading.Event();finished=threading.Event();failures=[]
        def polling():
            while not finished.wait(2):
                if enabled.is_set():
                    try:
                        snapshot,ms,size=get('/memory_map')
                        result['snapshots'].append({'time':time.time(),'http_ms':ms,'bytes':size,'shown':len(snapshot['nodes'])})
                    except Exception as error:failures.append(str(error))
        thread=threading.Thread(target=polling);thread.start()
        questions=['Explain why keeping a robot\'s memories on this device is useful.',
                   'How can you use the object I showed you in a conversation?',
                   'What is a useful example of combining text and visual memories?']
        try:
            for enabled_polling in [False,True,False,True]:
                if enabled_polling:enabled.set()
                else:enabled.clear()
                block={'polling':enabled_polling,'start':time.time(),'vm_start':vm(),'turns':[]}
                for question in questions:
                    turn=ask(question)
                    block['turns'].append({'question':question,'answer':turn.answer,
                        'speech_end':turn.speech_end,'first_text_ms':1000*(turn.first_token-turn.speech_end),
                        'speech_ready_ms':1000*(turn.first_audio-turn.speech_end),
                        'detect_fps':turn.detect_fps,'done':turn.done,'audio_s':turn.audio_s})
                block.update(end=time.time(),vm_end=vm());result['blocks'].append(block);save();print('block',enabled_polling,len(result['snapshots']),flush=True)
        finally:
            finished.set();thread.join(12)
        assert not failures,failures
        assert len(result['snapshots'])>=2, len(result['snapshots'])
        result['raw_seen_read_ms']=raw_reads
        result['checks']['polling_during_full_model_turns']=True
        # A new storage allocation is newer than the prior snapshot despite an old capture time.
        before,_,_=get('/memory_map')
        pid=robot.memory.add(None,'Delayed storage fixture',ts=1)
        # The current turn's new write stays visible even with an old capture timestamp.
        robot.ui_turn=main.Turn(line=time.time(),frame_id=pid)
        after,_,_=get('/memory_map')
        point=next(p for p in after['nodes'] if p['id']==f'seen:{pid}')
        assert point['created']>before['at']
        assert not after['recall']['ids'], 'A new write must not claim recall'
        result['checks']['storage_time_not_capture_time']=True
        robot.memory.forget([pid]);deleted,_,_=get('/memory_map')
        assert f'seen:{pid}' not in {p['id'] for p in deleted['nodes']}
        assert not deleted['recall']['ids']
        result['checks']['delete_purges_node_and_recall']=True
        def forget(f,c):
            robot.memory.forget_named(taught.named);robot.things.forget(taught.named)
        robot.recognition.call(forget,mutate=True)
        deleted,_,_=get('/memory_map')
        assert f'things:{taught.named}' not in {p['id'] for p in deleted['nodes']}
        assert not any(p.get('object')==f'things:{taught.named}' for p in deleted['nodes'])
        result['checks']['forget_purges_links']=True
    finally:robot.close()
result['complete']=True;result['elapsed_s']=time.time()-started
result['checks_passed']=all(result['checks'].values())
path=SHARED/'results'/f'{time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")}-memory-map-{int(started)}.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
limits: Four alternating blocks, three oracle turns per block, no audio playback. Short development smoke check. Paging counters cover complete blocks and cannot attribute paging to polling; response lengths and conversation history differ. No held-out quality, physical audible latency, long-session performance, or M4 acceptance claim.
